fields.label: Cluster
fields.description: Cluster whose mail this gateway sends. It provides the SSH key, the relay login and the Stalwart version.
Name of this server: one label under the cluster's default domain, e.g. out1.blr.frappemail.com. It gets an A record in the zone and is what the reverse DNS of the IP must point to.
fields.label: Hostname
Base URL
fields.description: Management URL of the gateway's own Stalwart: https:// plus the hostname.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Untick to take the gateway out of service. Pools that list its addresses stop working until another gateway hosts them.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Pending
Provisioning
Provisioned
Active
Failed
Disabled
fields.description: Pending: created, not provisioned. Provisioning: a job is running. Provisioned: installed, waiting for its certificate and API key. Active: relaying. Failed: the job or health check failed, see Last Error. Disabled: stopped by an operator.

fields.label: Stalwart Version
fields.description: Stalwart release the gateway runs. Defaults to the cluster's version. Change it and run Upgrade.
Public IPv4 of the VPS, used for SSH, the gateway's A record and management. The addresses mail leaves from are listed on the pools; this one can be among them.
fields.label: IPv4 Address
SSH User
fields.description: User Ansible logs in as. Leave blank to use the cluster's SSH user.

fields.label: SSH Port
fields.description: Leave blank to use the cluster's SSH port.

fields.label: SSH Verified
fields.description: Verify SSH reached the server with the cluster's key. Required before Provision; reset when the IP changes.
Where this gateway's own Stalwart keeps its queue and settings. A gateway shares nothing with the cluster, so a local RocksDB store is created when left blank.
fields.label: Data Store
Admin Username
fields.description: Administrator account of the gateway's Stalwart, created during bootstrap.

fields.label: Admin Password
fields.description: Generated on save. Used once to mint the API key; Show Admin Password is not offered for gateways, read it from the database if ever needed.

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: Bearer token Suite Cloud uses to push listeners and connection strategies to the gateway. Minted when provisioning finishes.

fields.label: Installed Version
fields.description: Stalwart release the last job installed on this gateway.

fields.label: Config Version
fields.description: Increases every time the gateway plan is pushed.

fields.label: Provisioned At
fields.description: When the last provisioning or upgrade job finished successfully.

fields.label: Last Config Sync At
fields.description: When the gateway plan was last pushed, either by a job or after a pool changed.

fields.label: Last Error
fields.description: Why the last job, health check or configuration push failed. Cleared by the next success.

fields.label: Config Plan
fields.description: Last generated gateway plan, secrets redacted: certificate domain, relay account, one listener and connection strategy per pool.
